verdict.rationale: Fin connects to business systems through MCP or API Data Connectors. Ready-made connector templates for Stripe, Shopify and Statuspage are generally available, connector health can be tracked, and Procedures let Fin work through multi-step queries against third-party systems. Fin is also trained on 'your knowledge, data, policies' and markets personalized answers, so it clearly goes beyond generic help articles. missing for 10: explicit documentation that answers draw on specific customer fields such as plan, order status and account history; detail on how connector data reaches Fin's replies; independent or hands-on corroboration that live-data answers work in practice.
